study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset. Specifically, they used regional brain volumes from T1-weighted MRI scans and regional SUVR values from AV45 Amyloid PET scans as two input modalities. Both brain volumes and SUVR values were extracted from 66 cortical (Desikan-Killiany atlas) and 24 subcortical regions.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset Mueller et al., 2005 with Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) = 0 and no amyloid pathology. We used regional brain volumes extracted from T1-weighted MRI scans and regional Standardized Uptake Value Ratio (SUVR) values extracted from AV45 Amyloid PET scans as the two input modalities for our model
